extension.description: Classic ASP & VBScript language support powered by Mixin (`mixin lsp --asp-only`).
configuration.title: Classic ASP LSP
command.restartServer.title: Classic ASP LSP: Restart Language Server
command.showReferences.title: Classic ASP LSP: Show References
config.server.path.description: Path to the `mixin` executable used to run `mixin lsp --asp-only`. Leave empty to use a bundled `server/mixin` binary or `mixin` from `PATH`.
config.codeLens.references.description: Show reference-count CodeLens above Classic ASP / VBScript procedures, classes, and top-level declarations.
config.codeLens.includes.description: Show clickable CodeLens above Classic ASP `<!-- #include -->` directives.
config.inlayHints.variableTypes.descript: Show inferred variable type inlay hints (`As Type`) on Classic ASP / VBScript `Dim` and `Const` declarations.
config.inlayHints.returnTypes.descriptio: Show inferred return type inlay hints (`As Type`) on Classic ASP / VBScript `Function` and `Property` declarations.
config.inlayHints.parameterNames.descrip: Show parameter name inlay hints (`param:`) on calls to user-defined Classic ASP / VBScript procedures.
config.inlayHints.scopeMarkers.descripti: Include `(local)` / `(global)` scope markers in Classic ASP / VBScript variable type inlay hints.
config.onTypeFormatting.description: Enable automatic indentation on Enter and `%>` inside Classic ASP / VBScript regions.
config.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the Classic ASP language server.
